title: Hiking Grade Calculator
description: Trail grade % from elevation gain and distance, with a difficulty rating and time estimate.
howto: Enter the elevation gain and the trail distance (choose units).
Read the average grade % and the difficulty rating.
See a Naismith-rule time estimate for the hike.

faqs.a: Elevation gain divided by horizontal distance, times 100. A 100 m climb over 1 km is a 10% grade.
Allow 1 hour per 5 km of distance plus 1 hour per 600 m of ascent. It is a classic hill-walking estimate.

faqs.q: Why might the real hike differ?
faqs.a: Terrain, altitude, pack weight, fitness, and weather all change the time. Treat it as a baseline.
